title: af/TaskExecutionStarted@1
description: The marker that a lease began kernel execution of its Task (ADR-0153, design §5 "Retained history"). The Task runtime commits it once per lease, before anything else it does under that lease, carried inline by one `execution_started` TaskTransition@5 that references no artifact and never changes the Task's result. A lease that only planned (`af task start` without `--execute`), decided, refreshed or swept writes none, so the markers before a lease count exactly the executions before it; Telemetry numbers a run's executions from them. It is written identically at every telemetry level.
